description: The dashboard adds a persistent, resizable, tabbed terminal dock and detached terminal windows for interacting with AppHost-owned or resource terminals, alongside a new state-based rendering engine (`@hex1b/web-terminal`) that replaces xterm.js with Kitty Graphics Protocol and Sixel support, improved copy/paste, a WebGPU renderer with WebGL2 fallback, and font-size/sizing controls that persist across dock and detached windows.
name: Terminal dock, detached windows, and new rendering engine
